claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the Biomedical domain involves recognizing entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs.
NER systems extract medical problems, tests, and treatments from clinical texts like discharge summaries and progress notes.
NER encompasses various tasks that apply state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing techniques, including Relation Extraction.
The biomedical domain presents unique challenges for NER, including reliance on hand-crafted features and ambiguities in entity names.
